title: RiboUnmix: Learning Shared Translational Dynamics from Biased and Noisy Ribo-seq Measurements
abstract: arXiv:2609.39644v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ribosome profiling (Ribo-seq) measures ribosome distributions along mRNAs, but observed occupancy profiles also contain experiment-specific distortions and stochastic variability. Consequently, models that accurately predict measured profiles may reproduce technical effects rather than recover the underlying biology. We ask whether jointly modeling datasets collected under different experimental conditions can reveal shared, sequence-dependent patterns of ribosome occupancy. We introduce RiboUnmix, a probabilistic multi-dataset framework in which each expected measured profile is represented as a shared sequence-dependent signal modulated by a dataset-specific multiplicative factor. A negative-binomial observation model captures variability across replicates. We evaluate RiboUnmix on a controlled synthetic benchmark combining programmed translation kinetics, ribosome traffic, stochastic count sampling, and sequence-dependent experimental

translated_title: RiboUnmix：从有偏且带噪的Ribo-seq测量数据中学习共享的翻译动力学
translated_abstract: 核糖体分析（Ribo-seq）技术可以测量核糖体沿mRNA的分布，但观测到的占据谱同时也包含实验特异性的扭曲和随机变异性。因此，能够准确预测测量谱的模型可能重现的是技术效应，而非潜在的生物学规律。我们探讨是否可以通过联合建模在不同实验条件下收集的数据集，来揭示共享的、依赖于序列的核糖体占据模式。我们提出了RiboUnmix，这是一个概率性的多数据集框架，其中每个预期的测量谱被表示为一个共享的、依赖于序列的信号，并由数据集特异性的乘性因子进行调制。负二项观测模型用于捕捉重复实验间的变异性。我们在一个受控的合成基准上评估RiboUnmix，该基准结合了程序化的翻译动力学、核糖体交通、随机计数采样以及依赖于序列的实验（效应）……
tldr: RiboUnmix是一个概率性多数据集框架，通过将测量谱建模为共享的序列依赖信号与数据集特异性乘性因子的组合，从有偏且带噪的Ribo-seq数据中分离出真正的共享翻译动力学规律。
en_tdlr: RiboUnmix is a probabilistic multi-dataset framework that recovers shared, sequence-dependent translational dynamics from biased and noisy Ribo-seq measurements by modeling each profile as a shared signal modulated by dataset-specific multiplicative factors with a negative-binomial observation model.
